title: Workaround: Members Selecting Multiple Top Level Categories
text:
## Workaround: Members Selecting Multiple Top Level Categories
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057947
The way that the software is designed, all members can only select one Top Level Category. There is a workaround however that will allow members to select Multiple Top Level Categories.
The site owner will need to create a General Top-level category that captures all of the members, then have the rest of the categories as sub and sub-subcategories.

## Step 1 - Add Categories to CSV File
Edit the CSV file that has been used to upload the Category Structure and add a new column or create a new CSV. file for this process.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12051675334/original/Nc8M4uj0hdFqPfH3fdZh-b6sU-Eg_6D-AQ.png?1559677714 | alt: ]
With this workaround, here’s the updated file structure:
The old Top Level Categories now function as Sub-Categories .
The old Sub-Categories now function as Sub-Sub-Categories .
We’re using “ Hidden Top Category ” as an example name, but you should replace it with something that fits your site. This label will appear on the front end in links, so choose a name that makes sense for your visitors.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12051675464/original/8kUhlW1ykDsgLIjHJmgvnPu9NTQ0sqrNaA.png?1559677858 | alt: ]
Now proceed to re-upload the new category structure using the CSV file. To access this file, feel free to click on this link: http://managemydirectory.com/admin/member-category-structure-import-sample.csv or use the option that can be found on the screen after clicking on the Import Categories in the backend of the site. (see image below)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314343/original/omCde-fiRUf5d7EUaydXea7TAiO9vYxhiA.png?1764630308 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314346/original/qc8s6HPljwukyZZY98b3mvBzhOs1BDUuAQ.png?1764630326 | alt: ]
CRITICAL DATABASE IMPACT: Selecting the option to delete existing categories will permanently erase all current category assignments across every active profile. Existing members will be forced to manually re-select their categories. This workaround is recommended for brand-new directory setups containing zero or few members.

## Step 2 - Pre-Select the Top Level Category
1. Finance » Membership Plans » Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314500/original/PKNgfY1t4RQpqFuNkExeW79jjH8_B8Y4Iw.png?1764630539 | alt: ]
2. Once inside the "Edit" screen search for the setting inside the General tab » Pre-Select Top Category :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314553/original/y6ZqLAHgGs5L8qVzB6A1eDu0uGfuClY4cQ.png?1764630583 | alt: ]

## Step 3 - Hide the Hidden Top-Level Category
To get started, complete the following steps:
1. Navigate to Toolbox » Form Manager. Locate and edit the specific contact form utilized by the target membership plan (e.g., Listing - Contact Details)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314805/original/KlloYD9BQZOdUPXLoNcztXhcDogoNN9tOA.png?1764630968 | alt: ]
2. Locate the profession_id field row. Click the Gear Icon to open field settings and disable the Input View toggle to hide the single selection element from the member dashboard.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180120677/original/EfWNJHTAmpDvKDFjnzDwYHhbnCIK8pEq_g.png?1781010527 | alt: ]
3. Save the form changes.

## Member Form: Category Workaround
Logging in as a member, it is now possible to select more than one Category and Sub Category from the Listing Details Tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12078322964/original/feo8TSDPurXrM4gaqd3Lo5FR2Y9pVA3m6g.png?1591635400 | alt: ]

## Homepage Search Module
Navigate to Settings » Design Settings . Under the Search Box / Call to Action setting, select a call to action option that does not include a Top-Level filter.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314617/original/8LK1FajpZW6cKfYxAZ20PhWJrdNt6pyYuQ.png?1764630679 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171314779/original/nGjA8nFbTdongp_aeCJus9fkFFbR63KVyw.png?1764630846 | alt: ]

## Final Front-End Polish
To ensure the placeholder "Hidden Top Category" label does not visibly display on live member profiles, complete the final visibility steps outlined in the dedicated guide:
How To Hide Top-Level Category From Member's Profile Page
